comment: Group Policy Objects (GPOs) for complete Tier Model deployment. Changes yearly with security baseline updates from Microsoft SCT, STIG, CIS, and organizational requirements.

PostConfigureGpo.name: *- Tier Model Account Restrictions
PostConfigureGpo.gpoComment: The focus of the GPO is to deny members of AD groups that are Tier 0 1 and 2 level of access such as Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, etc. Outside of endpoints that are Tier 0 such as Domain Controllers and other agents or supporting endpoints within Tier 0. The GPO ACL has an explicit deny to the Domain Controllers group to ensure this policy even if accidently enforced will never apply to Domain Controllers. This GPO does not apply security controls for the local builtin\Administrators group on endpoints. Windows LAPS is recommended security control to randomize passwords.
